in_arabic.name: ناروس
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Naurus is derived from the Arabic word 'نار' (nār) which means 'sun' and the suffix '-وس' (-ūs) which means 'light' or 'source'. Thus, Naurus can be interpreted as 'the light of the sun' or 'the source of light from the sun'.

in_urdu.name: ناروس

in_hindi.name: नारूस
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Naurus is translated as 'the light of the sun'. This meaning is derived from the Arabic origin of the name.

in_pashto.name: ناروس
in_pashto.long_meaning: The name Naurus in Pashto is translated as 'sun's light' or 'the light from the sun'. This meaning is derived from the Arabic origin of the name.
